title: REST control-plane defaults switched to receipts

evidence.description: All REST write endpoints return 202 CommandReceipt by default. No synchronous fallback mode exists. Frontend uses Nostr directly for mutations.
key_findings: REST handlers have no sync/compatibility mode toggle
Frontend web client only calls read endpoints; all mutations use Nostr directly
No X-Sync or synchronous mode headers/query params exist in the codebase
